title: Horse: the leg is blocked by the orthogonal step, not by the destination
rationale: The horse on e5 has eight destinations and reaches each through one orthogonal step. The soldier on e6 stands on the step for d7 and f7, so both are illegal while the six reached through e4, d5 and f5 remain legal: what blocks a horse is the leg square, never the destination, which is empty in all eight cases.
